summary: Master cap rates and property valuation metrics. Learn NOI, DCF, and IRR modeling to drive commercial real estate investment success. Enroll today.
lede: Cap rates and property valuation metrics relate a commercial property’s income potential to its value and inform investment decisions. Designed for investment analysts, asset managers, commercial mortgage underwriters and portfolio managers, the course covers normalizing operating income, deriving market cap rates and building discounted cash flow models. It also addresses debt-service measures, leveraged returns and sensitivity analysis for vacancy, rent growth and exit assumptions.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals who are responsible for the financial performance, acquisition, or financing of commercial real estate assets.
audience: Private Equity Associates focused on value-add real
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of financial statements (Balance Sheet, P&L) and be proficient in Microsoft Excel. Prior experience in real estate, finance, or accounting is recommended but not required.
